mechanism.claim: When ordinary and extreme fluctuations in a completed high-variation BTC path share unusually similar detrended scaling exponents, the repricing is a scale-coherent cascade rather than isolated heterogeneous jumps. A new lower-tail generalized-Hurst gap should continue in the completed displacement direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: Rescaled-range estimates one Hurst-like slope, Higuchi estimates graph dimension, Haar and DFT candidates allocate spectral energy, and recurrence candidates count repeated states. HVMFCR uses the cross-moment MF-DFA scaling gap abs(h1-h4), with no prior event set or control reused.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily onsets from a cross-moment scaling gap are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_window: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.returns: 480 log(close/open) minute returns, finite; completed block return log(last close/first open) strict nonzero
features.profile: cumulative sum of returns after subtracting the 480-return arithmetic mean
features.segmentation: forward exact non-overlapping segments at each scale; all scales divide 480
features.detrending: within every segment OLS intercept plus integer position 0..s-1; population mean squared residual strict positive
features.fluctuation: F_q(s)=[mean(segment_variance^(q/2))]^(1/q) for q in {1,4}, finite strict positive
features.generalized_hurst: h_q is OLS slope of log(F_q(s)) on log(s) across all nine frozen scales
features.gap_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded; rank<=0.25
features.h1_rank_control: strict-prior h1 midrank under the same 270/180 history; diagnostic q1_persistence requires rank>=0.75
features.realized_variation: sum squared minute returns, finite strict positive
features.onset: eligible now and immediately previous exact source-valid block ineligible

clock.decision: D after the full path completes
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact realized funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no scale, moment, detrending, gap, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, or control repair
